data.name: Mubassir
data.gender_notes: Mubassir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'basara' which means to see, perceive or announce. In Islamic context, it refers to a person who delivers the message of Allah through preaching or teaching. The name Mubassir carries the meaning “Announcer, Preacher, Speaker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubassir usually hope their child will grow to embody announcer, preacher, speaker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To illuminate the path of truth and knowledge.
data.etymology: Mubassir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Announcer, Preacher, Speaker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubassir total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مبشر
in_arabic.meaning: مبشر کا مطلب ہے خوشخبری دینے والا، شاداب کرنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبشر (Mubassir) کا نام العربية زبان میں 'بشر' (Bashara) سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشخبری دینا یا شاداب کرنا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے رسولوں کو بشارت دینے والوں کے طور پر بیان کرتے ہیں۔ اس نام کا روحانی مطلب یہ ہے کہ جو شخص خوشحالی اور امید کا پیغام دیتا ہے، وہ ایک مبارک اور انعام دینے والا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی سنہ پر مشتمل ہے اور اکثر ان لوگوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اچھی خبر یا مبارک واقعہ کا باعث بنتے ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: مبشر
in_urdu.meaning: مبشر کا مطلب خوشخبری دینے والا، امید کی کرن ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبشر (Mubassir) کا نام عربی زبان کی 'بشر' (Bashara) جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشخبری دینا یا امید کی کرن۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام انبیاء اور رسولوں کے ساتھ منسلک ہے جو اللہ کی طرف سے خوشخبری اور امید کا پیغام لاتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ کسی ایسے شخص کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جو مثبت خبر یا مبارک واقعہ کا باعث بنتا ہے، اور اسے اکثر ان لوگوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے آس پاس کے لوگوں کو امید اور خوشی دیتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुबश्शिर
in_hindi.meaning: मुबश्शिर का अर्थ है खुशखबरी देने वाला, आशा की किरण
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबश्शिर (Mubassir) नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के 'बशार' (Bashara) से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है खुशखबरी देना या आशा की किरण। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो सकारात्मक समाचार या शुभ घटना का कारण बनता है। यह नाम अक्सर उन लोगों को दिया जाता है जो अपने आसपास के लोगों को आशा और खुशी प्रदान करते हैं और इन्हें एक अच्छे शगुन के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_english.name: Mubassir
in_english.meaning: Mubassir means one who gives good news or brings hope
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mubassir originates from the Arabic root 'bashara,' which means to give good news or bring hope. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with prophets and messengers who brought messages of hope and guidance from Allah. The spiritual significance of Mubassir is that of a person who brings positive change, hope, and joy to those around them. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person who is a harbinger of good news or a blessed event. The personality traits associated with Mubassir include being optimistic, encouraging, and a source of inspiration to others.

A Mubassir is someone who has a deep understanding of Islamic teachings and is responsible for spreading this knowledge to others. They play an essential role in the community as they help to preserve and transmit the faith from one generation to another.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 4, Page 134 The name Mubassir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mubassir Ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari was one of the prominent Sahabah (Companions of the Prophet). He was also known as 'Mubassir Al-Kufi' due to his migration to Kufa. He participated in various battles and was a narrator of Hadith (sayings and actions of the Prophet).

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Masudi's Muruj Al-Dhahab, Volume 2, Page 199 The name Mubassir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Mubassir Ibn Fadl Al-Jauhari was an Andalusian scholar, poet, and historian. He was born in Granada and lived during the Abbasid period. He wrote a notable work titled 'Al-Aghani' which is a collection of Arabic poetry from pre-Islamic and Islamic eras.

Instagram, with its visual storytelling capability, has various accounts like 'Mubassir_Quran' that share beautiful Quranic verses along with their English translations, making the Islamic teachings accessible to a wider audience.
